title: Consultly
tagline: Secure face-to-face consultations over the P2P network and stream money only for the time used permissionless.
description:
Time-based consultations become inefficient as the clients cannot pay for the time of consultant used. It also helps consultants to optimize for time and if any of their clients are taking more time than allocated they get paid for it.

Consultly enables face-to-face consultation and streaming money for the only time used during the consultation. Built on top of Huddle01 and SuperFluid.
how_its_made: I was new to Superfluid SDK it took some time to understand the architecture and implement it. Asked for the help to mentors.
